Defining clear quality evaluation dimensions
quality_gates: All 30 tools identified and categorized
Acceptance criteria measurable for each mode

phases.purpose: Design system architecture, module decomposition, data flow, and technology choices.
key_challenges: Designing the unified ReAct engine
Integrating WebSocket, CLI, VSCode, and REST interfaces
Ensuring extensibility for new tools
quality_gates: All modules identified with clear responsibilities
Data flow diagrams for interactive review
Technology stack finalized

phases.purpose: Implement the DevAgent codebase including agent core, tools, pipeline, interaction, and VSCode extension.
key_challenges: Implementing 30 tools with consistent interface
Building real-time WebSocket communication
Integrating LLM providers (DeepSeek, OpenAI)
quality_gates: All tools implemented and registered
CLI modes functional
API endpoints working
VSCode extension installable

phases.purpose: Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests for all components.
key_challenges: Testing LLM-dependent components
Simulating interactive review scenarios
Achieving high coverage across 30 tools
quality_gates: Unit test coverage >80%
Integration tests for all modes
E2E test for full pipeline

risk_assessment.risk: LLM API instability or cost overruns
risk_assessment.mitigation: Implement fallback between DeepSeek and OpenAI; cache responses; set usage limits.

risk_assessment.risk: Complexity of real-time WebSocket interaction may cause delays or bugs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Use established WebSocket libraries; thorough testing with simulated clients.

risk_assessment.risk: VSCode extension compatibility issues across versions
risk_assessment.mitigation: Target latest stable VSCode API; test on multiple platforms.

risk_assessment.risk: Quality evaluation metrics may not align with user expectations
risk_assessment.mitigation: Involve users early; iterate on evaluation dimensions based on feedback.
